question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: uniform

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Uniformity **means the quality or fact of being the same, or of not changing or being different in any way
 
• **Uniforms **is a plural form of Uniform.
 
• **Uniform **means an identifying outfit or style of dress worn by the members of a given profession, organization, or rank. 
 
• **Uniformly **means in a way that is the same in all cases and at all times.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words uniform is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• In the given sentence **'his' **is mentioned so the singular form uniform should be used.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 3.

He never complained (5)______ that generation of army men didn’t air their problems. His son Michael once offered to take him back to Normandy when World War II veterans (6)______ the journey but his father shook (7)______ head saying, “I’ve been there once.” Sadly, Mr. Miller, 96 years old, (8)______ survived the bloodiest battle of World War II, died of (9)______ from the coronavirus on March 30 (10)______ an Old Soldiers’ Home.*
